within_process.note: spread across warm repeats inside one invocation, as a fraction of that invocation's warm minimum

between_process.note: movement of work_warm_min itself across separate invocations -- the variance a cell-vs-cell comparison is actually exposed to

rule: A difference between two cells is reportable only if it exceeds resolution_floor_frac of the smaller figure. Below that it is not a difference.
